overview: Beyond Mode Collapse paper proposes Generative Flow Networks for diverse synthetic expert dialogues, addressing AI safety and data variety.
Google DeepMind unveiled Gemini 4 Argon, a long‑context model targeting software engineering, enterprise tasks and cyber defense, highlighting scaling and pricing.
OpenAI disclosed a coordinated adversarial distillation attack extracting protected reasoning, prompting industry‑wide mitigation efforts.

top.title: Beyond Mode Collapse: Generating Diverse Synthetic Expert Conversations via Generative Flow Networks
top.summary: The arXiv paper introduces Generative Flow Networks to generate varied synthetic expert conversations, aiming to reduce mode collapse and improve training data diversity for conversational AI systems.

top.title: Gemini 4 Argon: our next era of frontier intelligence
top.summary: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Argon, a frontier model with up to 1 million token context, optimized for coding, reasoning, multimodal tasks, and cybersecurity, initially rolled out via a trusted‑partner program.

top.title: Disrupting a coordinated model-distillation campaign
top.summary: OpenAI reported disrupting a large‑scale adversarial distillation campaign that extracted protected model reasoning, highlighting a new security threat and prompting shared mitigations across the frontier‑model community.

top.title: Introducing SynthID Bio
top.summary: DeepMind presented SynthID Bio, a proof‑of‑concept watermarking technique for AI‑generated protein sequences that preserves biological function while enabling provenance tracking.

top.title: Helping small businesses put AI to work
top.summary: OpenAI partnered with America’s SBDC to train advisors and run workshops, helping small businesses adopt AI tools; a new report shows 4 million small‑firm employees used OpenAI services in one week.

top.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Argon, called its most powerful model yet
top.summary: TechCrunch reports Google’s Gemini 4 Argon launch, emphasizing its defensive cybersecurity capabilities, long‑context reasoning, and claimed benchmark superiority over competing models such as OpenAI’s Astra and Anthropic’s Fable.
